{"hypotheses": [
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 1",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high marketing expense and strong governance, but low tangible assets, are more likely to invest effectively in customer acquisition, leading to higher future returns.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AdExp"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Governance"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "tang"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 2",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high capital investment growth and low tangible assets, but high earnings consistency, are more likely to innovate and generate future growth.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrLTNOA"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "tang"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "CF", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 3",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high earnings surprise and low book to market ratio are more likely to outperform during periods of market downturns due to greater resilience.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 4",
    "mechanism": "Firms with low idiosyncratic risk and high total accruals are more likely to outperform during periods of market upturns due to less risk and stronger financial performance.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "TotalAccruals"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.5,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 5",
    "mechanism": "Firms with low book leverage and high bid-ask spread are more likely to outperform during periods of positive term spread due to less financial risk and higher liquidity premium.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 6",
    "mechanism": "Firms with low tangible assets and high return on equity are more likely to outperform during periods of positive term spread due to less asset-based risk and higher operational efficiency.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RoE"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "tang"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 7",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high intangible returns and low idiosyncratic risk are more likely to outperform during periods of market upturns due to their innovative ability and lower risk.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanEP"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {
    "name": "Hypothesis 8",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high organizational capital and low book-to-market ratio are more likely to outperform during periods of market downturns due to their valuable intangible assets and resilience.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OrgCap"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  }
]}
